body:
### IMPORTANT NOTE: This release enables shrinking and minification. If you run into any crashes, please report them with logs if possible.

🚀 **Improvements**  
- Improved DEX optimization for the build for performance and minification
- Improved SVG rendering to use Glide for performance
- Open upstream repository of a fork when clicking the fork card

🐛 **Bug Fixes**  
- Fixed merge PR when approvals are set and user is admin
- Fixed notifications default mode
- Fixed invalid issue opened via URL scheme

📝 **Notes**  
- Use Forgejo **17.0.x** OR Gitea **28.x** or above.

📩 **Download Files**  
- [Downloads](https://codeberg.org/gitnex/GitNex#user-content-downloads)
